svg.title: From signals to embedding vectors
svg.desc: Two series, walking and running, are frozen at two timestamps. Each view of each series yields a two dimensional embedding vector, listed with concrete numbers, and the four vectors at the first timestamp are plotted as arrows showing that the two views of each series point in similar directions.
svg.text: The four vectors at t1, drawn as arrows
Two views of one series point almost the same way. Different series diverge.
